# Mary Vance

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v5 c8 P4](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v5 c35 P9](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Hopetown asylum  <sub>[v5 c5 P108](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0108)</sub>

## Appearance

Mary Vance has long, flexible fingers and white, queer eyes that stand out on her face. After living with Miss Cornelia, her face becomes plump and her cheeks rosy. She wears her hair elaborately crimped.

_Sources: [v5 c6 P31](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0031), [v5 c18 P5](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0005), [v5 c31 P28](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0028)_

## Personality

Mary possesses a queer, wild charm and a jolly, stimulating nature, though she is brutally frank and frequently lectures her companions. She is not overly sensitive about her own feelings, but she is fiercely loyal to her friends and eager to defend them. Highly astutely minded, shrewd, and confident, she often boasts of her capabilities and insists she can accomplish anything she sets her mind to. However, she holds strong pessimistic prejudices, particularly regarding stepmothers, and enjoys telling terrifying ghost stories.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P87](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0087), [v5 c6 P30](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0030), [v5 c6 P31](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0031), [v5 c8 P0](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0000), [v5 c8 P2](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0002), [v5 c9 P80](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0080), [v5 c18 P5](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0005), [v5 c23 P4](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0004), [v5 c23 P40](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0040), [v5 c25 P8](../source/v05-c25.md#nw-v05-c25-p0008), [v5 c33 P1](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0001)_

## History

After running away from the abusive Mrs. Wiley, Mary Vance was found starving in James Taylor's old hay barn by the Meredith children, who took her in and befriended her. She quickly joined the circle of children in Rainbow Valley, sharing new games, shadow pictures, and ghost stories. When Rilla Blythe angered her, Mary chased and terrified her with a dried codfish, but she later felt repentant for her behavior. Following Mrs. Wiley's death, Miss Cornelia Elliott took Mary into her home to raise her, work her into shape, and teach her religious instruction. Under Miss Cornelia's care, Mary flourished into a plump, well-dressed, and exceptionally hard worker. She continued to hang around Rainbow Valley as a lively companion, frequently lecturing the Merediths and warning them against the dangers of stepmothers.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P87](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0087), [v5 c6 P30](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0030), [v5 c6 P31](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0031), [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014), [v5 c8 P2](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0002), [v5 c8 P4](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0004), [v5 c8 P39](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0039), [v5 c9 P44](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0044), [v5 c9 P80](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0080), [v5 c12 P36](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0036), [v5 c18 P5](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0005), [v5 c23 P4](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0004), [v5 c23 P40](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0040), [v5 c35 P9](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0009)_
